blurb: Guests can visit the Smyrna tap room Thursday through Sunday to explore meads, ciders, cysers, and seltzers. The tap room offers flights of 5 meads for $8.50 and growler fills for take-home mead. Membership clubs provide discounts, perks, and quarterly shipments of curated meads.
extraNote: Horn Club is an annual membership with a one-time horn purchase · Alchemist Club ships quarterly with discounts and early access · Smyrna Tap Room at 3080 Jonquil Dr., Smyrna, GA 30080
